premises.text: Enterprises need massive-scale, hyper-fast SQL because traditional databases take prohibitively long on large joins
premises.evidence_span: it was taking our enterprise database server 35 hours to run

premises.text: A GPU-based distributed SQL engine turns tables into matrices and parallelizes computation across thousands of GPU cores
premises.evidence_span: take a table in a database and turn it into a matrix

premises.text: Server-side software deploys on cloud or on-prem with interfaces that connect existing code, workbenches, and SQL analysts
premises.evidence_span: You can deploy it onto the cloud or an appropriately configured on-premise rig

premises.text: A free community edition broadens access while enterprise pilots serve large-data companies
premises.evidence_span: we're launching a community edition version of a GPU SQL database that is free to use for life
